2  JUDGMENT (PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.T.NARENDRA PRASAD)

This appeal is filed by the claimants under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act')
challenging the judgement and award dated 05.05.2016 in MVC No.576/2015 by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal-XII, Bellary (hereinafter for short 'Tribunal'), whereby Tribunal has granted Rs.4,00,000/- as compensation with interest at 7% p.a.
2.
Brief facts of the case are that on 24.05.2014, petitioner-Kum.Manya travelling in Maruthi Omni along with other persons.

When the Tipper Lorry bearing Regn.No.GA- 09/U-2767 reached near Vidyanagar main gate at about 1.45 p.m. on 24.05.2014, driver of the lorry has driven the lorry in rash and negligent manner and lost the control and the said lorry met with an accident.
In the said accident, Kum.Manya died in the spot.
The legal representatives of the deceased have filed the claim petition in MVC No.576/2015.
At the time of the death, the deceased was aged about 9 years.

Since,
the deceased was minor, the Tribunal after considering the material NC: 2024:KHC-D:17967 available on record has granted compensation of Rs.4,00,000/- along with interest at 7% p.a.
Being aggrieved by the same, the claimants are before this Court.

3. Smt.Sowbhagya Vakkund advocate appearing for Sri.Y.Lakshmikanth Reddy, counsel appearing for the claimants has contended that the Hon'ble Apex Court in case of Kishan Gopal and another Vs. Lala and others1 in case of minor death aged about 9 years has granted a compensation of Rs.5,00,000/- for the accident occurred in the year 1992.

entities.text: Kishan Gopal and another Vs. Lala and others1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the case in hand, the accident was occurred in the year 2014, the Tribunal has granted a compensation of Rs.4,00,000/- is on lower side.
Hence, sought for enhancement of compensation.

4. Per contra, Sri.R.R.Mane, learned counsel for the insurance company has contended that in the case of Kishan Gopal, there is a specific pleading that the deceased was aged about 10 years and assisting his father in the agriculture work.
Considering this, Tribunal has granted compensation of Rs.5,00,000/- taking Rs.30,000/- as annual income.
Therefore, he has contended that Tribunal after considering the material 2013 ACJ 2594 NC: 2024:KHC-D:17967 available on record has rightly granted the compensation of Rs.4,00,000/-.

He also contended that in the light of the Division Bench Decision of this Court in the case of Ms.Joyeeta Bose and others Vs. Venkateshan V.
and others(MFA No.5896/2018 and connected matters disposed of on 24.08.2020), the rate of interest awarded by the Tribunal at 7% p.a. on the compensation amount appears excessive.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
5. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties and perused the judgment and award of the tribunal.
6.
It is not in dispute that Kumari Manya died in road traffic accident occurred on 24.05.2014 due to rash and negligent driving of the driver of the lorry bearing No.GA-09/U- 2767.

The Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Kishan Gopal supra, has taken annual income of the deceased as Rs.30,000/-
per annum in the case of minor who was aged about 10 years.
In the case on hand, deceased was aged about 9 years.

Considering the evidence of the parties and judgment of Hon'ble Apex Court in Suhasini W/O Kumar Swamy vs H. Virupakshi S/O Shanthappa on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7623216/
3

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
the case of Kishan Gopal supra, the annual income of the deceased can be assessed as NC:
2024:KHC-D:17967 Rs.30,000/-, adopting multiplier as 15 this Court is going to grant a compensation of Rs.4,50,000/-.

7. In respect of conventional head is concerned, in view of the judgment of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of National Insurance Company Ltd. Vs. Pranaya Sethi2 and Magma General Insurance Company Ltd., Vs. Nanu Ram and others3 claimants are entitled for Rs.40,000/- each towards consortium, Rs.15,000/- towards loss of Estate and Rs.15,000/- towards funeral expenses.

8. Thus, the claimants are entitled to the following compensation:
 Compensation under Amount in  different Heads (Rs.)
 Loss of dependency 4,50,000-00  Funeral expenses 15,000-00  Loss of estate 15,000-00  Loss of Parental consortium 80,000-00  (Rs.40,000X2)
 Total 5,60,000-00  2017 ACJ 2700  2018 ACJ 2782  NC: 2024:KHC-D:17967 9.

In respect of interest is concerned, in view of the judgment of the Division Bench of this Court in the case Ms.Joyeeta Bose and others supra, rate of interest at 7% p.a. has to be scaled down to 6%
p.a.
10.

In the result, the following order is passed:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed.
ii) The judgment and award of the Tribunal is modified.
